Definition: from the same as G1017; to arbitrate, i.e. (genitive case) to govern (figuratively, prevail):--rule.
BiblicalUsage: brabeúō — to arbitrate, to rule — turns up in its single occurrence in Colossians. It is a small word, and it stays in its own lane.
TheologicalSignificance: To me, brabeúō is a small window into how precisely God speaks.
